   140	/-- Two morphisms from a reduced Jacobson scheme into a separated scheme are
   141	equal when their residue-field probes agree at every closed point. -/
   142	theorem morphism_eq_of_eqAt_closedPoints
   143	    {g₁ g₂ : W ⟶ Z}
   144	    (h : ∀ x ∈ closedPoints W,
   145	      W.fromSpecResidueField x ≫ g₁ = W.fromSpecResidueField x ≫ g₂) :
   146	    g₁ = g₂ := by
   147	  let F : closedPoints W → Scheme.{u} := fun x => Spec (W.residueField x.1)
   148	  let probe : (∐ F) ⟶ W := Sigma.desc fun x => W.fromSpecResidueField x.1
   149	  haveI : IsDominant probe := by
   150	    refine ⟨(dense_iff_closure_eq.mpr (closure_closedPoints (X := W))).mono ?_⟩
   151	    intro x hx
   152	    obtain ⟨pt⟩ : Nonempty (Spec (W.residueField x)) := inferInstance
   153	    refine ⟨(Sigma.ι F ⟨x, hx⟩).base pt, ?_⟩
   154	    have hcomp : Sigma.ι F ⟨x, hx⟩ ≫ probe = W.fromSpecResidueField x :=
   155	      Sigma.ι_desc _ _
   156	    have e1 : probe.base ((Sigma.ι F ⟨x, hx⟩).base pt) =
   157	        (W.fromSpecResidueField x).base pt := by
   158	      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hcomp]
   159	    rw [e1]
   160	    exact Set.eq_of_mem_singleton
   161	      (Scheme.range_fromSpecResidueField x ▸ Set.mem_range_self pt)
   162	  refine ext_of_isDominant probe (Sigma.hom_ext _ _ fun x => ?_)
   163	  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, Sigma.ι_desc]
   164	  exact h x.1 x.2
   165	
   166	end ClosedPointExtensionality

   176	/- A proper integral scheme over an algebraically closed field has no
   177	nonconstant maps to an affine scheme. -/
   178	theorem eq_comp_of_isAffine_of_properIntegral
   179	    [IsAlgClosed kbar]
   180	    {W : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral W] (wk : W ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of kbar))
   181	    [UniversallyClosed wk] [LocallyOfFiniteType wk]
   182	    {V : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine V] (g : W ⟶ V)
   183	    (a b : Spec (CommRingCat.of kbar) ⟶ W)
   184	    (ha : a ≫ wk = 𝟙 _) (hb : b ≫ wk = 𝟙 _) :
   185	    a ≫ g = b ≫ g := by
   186	  letI : Field Γ(W, ⊤) :=
   187	    (isField_of_universallyClosed (CommRingCat.of kbar) wk).toField
   188	  set F : CommRingCat.of kbar ⟶ Γ(W, ⊤) :=
   189	    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of kbar)).inv ≫ wk.appTop with hF
   190	  have hint : F.hom.IsIntegral := by
   191	    apply RingHom.isIntegral_respectsIso.2
   192	      (e := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv)
   193	    exact isIntegral_appTop_of_universallyClosed wk
   194	  haveI : IsIso F := (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective F).mpr
   195	    (IsAlgClosed.ringHom_bijective_of_isIntegral F.hom hint)
   196	  haveI : IsIso wk.appTop := by
   197	    have heq : wk.appTop = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of kbar)).hom ≫ F := by
   198	      rw [hF]
   199	      simp
   200	    rw [heq]
   201	    infer_instance
   202	  have haa : wk.appTop ≫ a.appTop = 𝟙 _ := by
   203	    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, ha]
   204	    simp
   205	  have hbb : wk.appTop ≫ b.appTop = 𝟙 _ := by
   206	    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, hb]
   207	    simp
   208	  have hab : a.appTop = b.appTop := by
   209	    rw [← cancel_epi wk.appTop, haa, hbb]
   210	  apply ext_of_isAffine
   211	  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, hab]

   213	/- Integrality descends along a scheme-theoretic retract.  The section makes
   214	the retraction surjective on points, while the stalk map of the retraction is
   215	injective because it is a factor of an isomorphism. -/
   216	theorem isIntegral_of_retract {S T : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral T]
   217	    (r : S ⟶ T) (pr : T ⟶ S) (hrp : r ≫ pr = 𝟙 S) : IsIntegral S := by
   218	  have hsurj : Function.Surjective pr.base := by
   219	    intro x
   220	    refine ⟨r.base x, ?_⟩
   221	    have h := congrArg (fun m => m.base x) hrp
   222	    simpa using h
   223	  haveI : IrreducibleSpace S := by
   224	    rw [irreducibleSpace_def]
   225	    have h := (IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ T).image pr.base
   226	      pr.base.hom.continuous.continuousOn
   227	    rwa [Set.image_univ, hsurj.range_eq] at h
   228	  haveI hstalk : ∀ x : S, _root_.IsReduced (S.presheaf.stalk x) := by
   229	    intro x
   230	    haveI hiso : IsIso ((r ≫ pr).stalkMap x) := by
   231	      rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_congr_hom (r ≫ pr) (𝟙 S) hrp x,
   232	        Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_id]
   233	      exact inferInstanceAs (IsIso ((S.presheaf.stalkCongr _).hom ≫ 𝟙 _))
   234	    rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp] at hiso
   235	    have hbij := (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective
   236	      (pr.stalkMap (r.base x) ≫ r.stalkMap x)).1 hiso
   237	    have hinj : Function.Injective (pr.stalkMap (r.base x)).hom := by
   238	      intro a b hab
   239	      apply hbij.injective
   240	      rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
   241	      exact congrArg (r.stalkMap x) hab
   242	    have hb : pr.base (r.base x) = x := by
   243	      have h := congrArg (fun m => m.base x) hrp
   244	      simpa using h
   245	    have hred : _root_.IsReduced (S.presheaf.stalk (pr.base (r.base x))) :=
   246	      isReduced_of_injective (pr.stalkMap (r.base x)).hom hinj
   247	    rwa [hb] at hred
   248	  haveI : IsReduced S := isReduced_of_isReduced_stalk S
   249	  exact isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced S
   250
